Bill proposes jail for insulting or disrupting Vande Mataram

A proposed bill in India could introduce a jail term of up to three years for individuals found to be insulting or disrupting the national song, Vande Mataram. The legislation aims to penalize such acts, with the potential for significant legal consequences for offenders. This move highlights a focus on national symbols and their perceived protection under law.
